{{Quote|Only a fraction of the Emperor's infiltrators have been activated to date. But Darth Caba has gathered intelligence reports, which indicate a high-ranking Serenno noble, who has the ear of Master Zallow, is secretly one of ours.|[[Darth Malgus]]|<ref name="Book of Sith" />}}
'''Darth Caba''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. In about [[3653 BBY]], Caba gathered a number of intelligence reports that suggested that a [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]-based [[Noble/Legends|noble]], an ally of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ven Zallow]], was in fact secretly an agent of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire.<ref name="Book of Sith" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Caba was mentioned in ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', a [[2012]] publication that was written by [[Daniel Wallace]]. Caba was originally set to appear in the online game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as the Head of Intelligence of the Sith Empire, and Wallace mentioned him in ''Book of Sith'' as a reference to some background material from ''The Old Republic'' that he had received. However, Caba did not make it into the final version of the game.<ref name="Book of Sith endnotes">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2012/03/endnotes-for-star-wars-book-of-sith_15.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: Book of Sith (part 2)}}</ref>
